description: Angular component for selecting and displaying time zones, including UI interactions, timezone info management, and integration with popover service.

classes.name: TimezoneComponent
classes.description: Angular component for timezone selection and display, implementing ControlValueAccessor for form integration.

methods.name: toggleTimezone
methods.description: Handles user interaction to open/close timezone selection popover.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Registers callback for touch event (not implemented).

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Sets the disabled state of the component.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Writes a new value to the component and updates timezone info.

methods.name: notifyChanged
methods.description: Calls the registered change callback with current value.

methods.name: displayValue
methods.description: Returns the display string for the current timezone.

methods.name: tooltipValue
methods.description: Returns tooltip string with timezone name and offset.

methods.name: updateDisplayValue
methods.description: Triggers change detection to update UI.

methods.name: setTimezoneInfo
methods.description: Determines and sets the timezone info based on current value.
